functions.name: attestation_envelopes
functions.description: Attestation envelope occurrences qualified by retrieval scope type and stable scope ID, subject digest and occurrence ordinal. Ordinals are positions within the selected invocation and predicate filter, not durable attestation identities or cross-route equivalence. Attestation envelope occurrences for a subject digest, preserving reported media type, bundle URL and initiator. The pinned verificationMaterial and dsseEnvelope values are arbitrary objects without typed fields, so their dynamic content remains explicitly uncovered. Bundle URLs are evidence and are not fetched. Listing metadata is not cryptographic signature, timestamp or signer verification. No durable attestation ID is supplied; ordinal identity applies only within this retrieval. Organization/user listings expose optional reported repository IDs but no repository locators. Nullable repository evidence is retained; users/list-attestations bodyless204 is empty, while its ambiguous201 empty-object alternative is not a completed attestation population and fails.

metrics.name: attestation_envelope_count
metrics.comment: Returned attestation envelope occurrences, not verified attestations.
